definitions.explanation: The amount of water vapor present in the air, typically expressed as a percentage.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{湿度|しつど}は80%だ。
{湿度|しつど}が{高|たか}いと{不快|ふかい}に{感|かん}じる。
{部屋|へや}の{湿度|しつど}を50%から60%に{保|たも}つのが{理想的|りそうてき}だと{言|い}われている。{乾燥|かんそう}しすぎると{風邪|かぜ}をひきやすくなる。
examples.english: It's said that keeping room humidity between 50% and 60% is ideal. If it gets too dry, you become more susceptible to colds.

notes:
{湿度|しつど} refers to humidity as a measurable quantity, typically expressed as a percentage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {湿度|しつど}が{高|たか}い (humidity is high)
- {湿度|しつど}が{低|ひく}い (humidity is low)
- {湿度|しつど}を{調整|ちょうせい}する (to adjust humidity)
- {湿度|しつど}○○% (humidity at X%)

RELATED TERMS:
- {温度|おんど} (temperature)
- {湿気|しっけ} (moisture, dampness - more tangible)
- {加湿器|かしつき} (humidifier)
- {除湿機|じょしつき} (dehumidifier)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {湿度|しつど}: numerical humidity measurement
- {湿気|しっけ}: physical dampness/moisture you can feel
